The '''Baliss staging grounds''' was an area in [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was used by the military forces of [[House Baliss]] as a staging ground during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
